assumption_tags.namespace_note: RP-* names physical postulates; disjoint from the computational-regime tags in dependency_tags.

claim_boundary: This proves, in a zero-axiom Rocq development kernel-rechecked by coqchk, that at every Fourier mode with a nonzero frequency the closed and exact 1-forms coincide, and that at the zero mode exactness forces vanishing while closedness is automatic. Hence the symplectic-to-Hamiltonian gap on T^4 is carried entirely by the zero mode and equals its four independent constant classes, for every truncation whatsoever.

closes_gate.how: The Forge gate computed the gap at N = 0,1,2,3. This proves the per-mode statement for EVERY mode. Since any truncation is a set of modes, the per-mode result subsumes every truncation at once -- a stronger closure than an induction over N, and it needs no induction at all: the potential at a nonzero mode is constructed explicitly from a direction whose frequency does not vanish.

does_not_establish: the marginal or volume-preserving levels of the chain; only the symplectic/Hamiltonian (closed/exact) structure is formalised
the per-mode rank computations, which remain the Forge gate's exact-rational computation
the arithmetic summing per-mode dimensions into the totals tabulated in the G1 report; those totals are still computational, not proved
anything about a general symplectic manifold; the model is the flat T^4 with its standard form
a reproduction, confirmation or refutation of Carcassi--Aidala's own derivation
an equivalence in the reverse-mathematics sense; proving one implication in Rocq is not a reversal over a base theory, and EQUIVALENCE_CERTIFIED remains unreached
any quantum, causal, or field-theoretic claim

theorems.name: exact_implies_closed
theorems.role: the easy inclusion; Hamiltonian implies symplectic
theorems.statement: at every mode, an exact 1-form is closed

theorems.name: closed_at_zero_mode
theorems.role: every constant vector field on the torus preserves omega

theorems.name: exact_at_zero_mode_iff_vanishing
theorems.role: the potential is a constant and d(constant) = 0, so the zero mode's classes are the whole space
theorems.statement: at k = 0 a 1-form is exact iff it vanishes identically

theorems.name: zero_mode_has_four_independent_classes
theorems.role: b_1(T^4) = 4 in coordinates: four independent classes
theorems.statement: at k = 0 exactness is equivalent to all four components vanishing

theorems.name: closed_iff_exact_at_nonzero
theorems.role: THE HEART: no cohomology away from the constants. The potential is built explicitly from a direction whose frequency does not vanish, so no bound on the mode is ever needed
theorems.statement: for every mode with some nonzero frequency, closed and exact COINCIDE

theorems.name: nonzero_mode_contributes_no_class
theorems.role: the quotient closed/exact is trivial there
theorems.statement: a nonzero mode contributes nothing to the gap

theorems.name: mode_dichotomy
theorems.role: exhaustiveness, via decidability of rational equality; this is why quantifying over modes subsumes quantifying over truncations
theorems.statement: every mode is either the zero mode or has a nonzero frequency

theorems.name: gap_is_carried_entirely_by_the_zero_mode
theorems.role: THE THEOREM. No truncation appears in the statement, so it holds for every N simultaneously
theorems.statement: for every mode k and every closed 1-form at k, either k is the zero mode or the form is exact

theorems.name: translation_is_closed_but_not_exact
theorems.role: the zero mode really does carry something; the witness is uniform translation on T^4
theorems.statement: the constant 1-form of X = d/dq1 is closed and not exact
